title: BookArc
shortDescription: Read free ebooks, listen to audiobooks, and receive books directly from authors. Bring your library with you.
fullDescription:
BookArc connects readers and authors.

Receive books and audiobooks from authors using claim codes, or discover free classic ebooks. Read in the BookArc app and keep your library and reading progress in sync with your BookArc account.

Bring your own EPUB and PDF files, customise your reading experience, and save bookmarks, highlights and notes. Download your books to read offline.

Create a free account in the app to access your BookArc library across devices, or import your own files to read locally.

BookArc is free for readers. No in-app purchases. No adverts.
featureBullets: Claim books and audiobooks shared directly by authors
Import and read your own EPUB and PDF files
Sync your library, reading progress, bookmarks and notes
